title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.1.0 — Real-World Accurate GPS & Silent Background Tracker
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.1.0:
• Removed GPS card and box from the UI per your request: now runs 100% silently in background
• Fixed incorrect location: added dual-tier resolver bypassing BlueStacks/emulator mock locations and locking real-world coordinates
• Background auto-dispatch when moving >= 10 meters
• Stationary 1-hour pulse: broadcasts exact coordinates every hour even if unchanged
• Complete offline queueing for GPS tracking (auto-pushes when internet reconnects)
• Enhanced background stability and minor bug fixes
